entries.description: Input/output alphabet is the 256 UTF-8 byte values; no tokenizer merges, no vocabulary.
Bounded recurrent working state; dimensions fixed by the architecture spec.

Memory keys are produced by a deterministic seeded random projection: the frozen memory encoder table (uniform in [-1,1), SplitMix64 stream tagged 'core.memory_encoder'), summed over hashed byte trigrams. No corpus statistics.
Learning-rate, bias-rate, epsilon, update-norm bound (delta rule) and rate, decay, trace, gain (Hebbian rule). Chosen on pilot seeds only and frozen before the main Phase 4 run.
Six teaching/control commands (teach, ask, correct, confirm, forget, repeat), the ' => ' delimiter, and control IDs BOS/EOS/PAD. Full list in model/bootstrap/seed.json.

Symbols, roles, and relation atoms are unit complex phasors with angles from SplitMix64 streams tagged by namespace and name; numbers use fractional-power encoding exp(i n theta) with a seeded base. Binding is elementwise complex multiplication.

Bounded statement/question grammar: about 45 function words, 8 comparatives (4 dimensions), number words zero-twenty, verb normalizations, and the pronoun 'it'. Content words are open. Operator semantics (class inclusion, transitivity, inheritance, comparison, arithmetic, temporal order, negation, conditionals) are programmed.

W_PROG constants are the deterministic output of the zerolm-wsp circuit compiler run on the typed specifications in model/prog/ (one entry per circuit below); each compiled circuit's SHA-256 is pinned in model/prog/pinned.json. Circuits encode algorithms only: no vocabulary, word list, fact, or corpus statistic.

Circuit memory-read (model/prog/memory-read.json): Phase 5 retrieval as a neural ISA program. Constants: a status-column selector and active-status window, attention inverse temperature 32 and minimum read weight 1e-7, read threshold 0.3 and coverage threshold 0.5 (from model/specs/memory.json), a key-word position index, a nearest-code score scale, and a top-2 margin selector.

Circuit relation-graph (model/prog/relation-graph.json, roadmap C5): decodes relation slots into a slot x symbol subject-similarity matrix, a one-hot object cleanup matrix (cosine >= 0.3), and polarity masks. Constants: role and metadata-column selectors, 1/d, 1/sqrt(d), 0.5, the cleanup threshold. No vocabulary or facts.

Circuit relation-reach (model/prog/relation-reach.json, roadmap C6): reachability over one relation as a fixed 8-step recurrence with a premise matrix, replacing breadth-first search. Constants: probe threshold 2 - 0.5, symbol cleanup threshold 0.9, an 8-step depth schedule and shift matrix, one enable scalar per Phase 6 operator, operator selectors.
